tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cool grey page background for every app.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and menus that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised` (light 16:1, dark 14:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Slate grey. Secondary text, captions and metadata on `surface` and `surface-raised` (light 5.8:1, dark 6.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders on `surface` and `surface-raised` (light 3.3:1, dark 3.4:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Signal blue. Primary buttons, highlights and the brand mark. Put `on-brand` on it. Also reads as text on `surface` and `surface-raised` (light 5.4:1, dark 5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` fills (light 5.8:1, dark 6.7:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cyan. Links, focus rings and selected states on `surface` and `surface-raised` (light 5.5:1, dark 7.7:1). Put `on-accent` on accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`, `success` and `danger` fills (5.7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Cool green. Success fills and text on `surface` (light 5.7:1, dark 8.7:1). Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions on `surface` (light 6.1:1, dark 7.6:1). Always pair with a word or icon.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: hero titles and empty states.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, badges, button text in dense UI.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps inside a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between related blocks, mobile gutter.
